entity.name: Ted Lasso
entity.description: Ted Lasso is a 2020 comedy-drama sports series developed by Jason Sudeikis, Bill Lawrence, Brendan Hunt and Joe Kelly. The show follows an upbeat American college football coach who is unexpectedly hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English Premier League club, and chronicles his unorthodox, empathetic approach to leadership as he transforms players, staff and the owner while confronting personal challenges. The series stars Jason Sudeikis alongside Hannah Waddingham, Brendan Hunt, Juno Temple, Jeremy Swift, Brett Goldstein, Phil Dunster, Nick Mohammed and Toheeb Jimoh. Across intimate character arcs and ensemble-driven storylines the show explores themes of teamwork, redemption, cultural clashes, mental health and the power of kindness, blending broad comedy with sincere drama and an overall uplifting emotional tone.

entity.name: The Wire
entity.description: The Wire (2002) is an American serialized drama created by David Simon and co-created by Ed Burns. Across five seasons it deploys a large ensemble cast—including Dominic West, Idris Elba, Michael K. Williams, Wendell Pierce, Lance Reddick, Sonja Sohn, Clarke Peters, Andre Royo and others—to chronicle the drug trade in an East Coast city and the institutions that interact with it. Each season shifts emphasis among police investigations, the drug organizations, municipal politics, the docks and unions, public schools, and the local press, using procedural detail and realistic dialogue to expose systemic dysfunction, bureaucratic incentives, and the human fallout of policy and poverty. Directed by a variety of filmmakers (notably Clark Johnson and Ernest Dickerson among others) and written by a team led by the creators and contributors such as George Pelecanos, the show is noted for its sociological approach, muted visual palette, patient pacing, and morally ambiguous storytelling. Its emotional tone is stark, unsentimental, and often melancholic, favoring realism and institutional critique over tidy resolutions.

entity.name: Parks and Recreation
entity.description: Parks and Recreation is a 2009 American comedy series created by Greg Daniels and Michael Schur that ran on NBC. Starring an ensemble cast led by Amy Poehler, the show uses a mockumentary format to follow a parks and recreation department in a fictional Indiana town as staffers navigate petty bureaucracy, community projects, romances, and local politics. Combining satirical takes on government and civic life with warm, character-driven storytelling, the series spotlights themes of public service, friendship, ambition, and small-town identity. Its tone mixes deadpan comedy and heartfelt optimism, and the show helped establish several breakout comedic actors while influencing later workplace and ensemble comedies.

baseline.title: Team Atlas: Off the Clock

6:15 — Share snacks and one non-work highlight from the week.
6:35 — Open conversation; swap favorite songs and shows.
7:15 — Optional round: everyone suggests one future team outing.
8:00 — Wrap up, with no pressure to stay for another round.
